discovered_from: LEANDRO browser 404 on V1.2 Engine watch page
root_cause: publish-content.mjs fetched a private Blob manifest URL without authenticated private get(), so each sequential publish reset manifest=[] and overwrote the manifest with only the latest item.
impact: V1.2 media blobs existed, but only the last consolidated V1.2 record remained discoverable by Content Hub.
repair: Rebuilt private manifest atomically with 8 records (V1.1 + V1.2).
Changed publisher to use @vercel/blob get(...,{access:'private'}) before merge.
Validated all four V1.2 watch routes HTTP 200 and media routes HTTP 200.
